answer: To keep one identity from minting a crowd of cheap twins, the intake house at Mile 7 treats a physical coupon as the only seat ticket. Each claimant files one ferrous coupon, serial punched, then a four-wire bench must read 41.8 to 42.6 milliohms at 19 C after a copper stamp is pressed on the coupon face for 11 seconds under 9.5 newtons. The coupon is then hung on the river intake hook for a 90-second wet soak; a second coupon, a reused serial, or a reading outside that band burns a 27.6 POA bond and bars the hook for eight shifts.
